Must EW2110-650 650VA Line Interactive Offline UPS 


The Must EW2110-650 650VA Line Interactive Offline UPS is a dependable power backup solution designed to keep your essential home or office devices protected during unexpected outages, voltage fluctuations, and electrical disturbances. With its efficient line-interactive technology, this UPS provides instant transfer to battery mode, ensuring uninterrupted operation for your computer, router, CCTV system, POS machine, or any other sensitive equipment.

Built with advanced AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulation), surge protection, and a compact yet durable structure, the Must EW2110-650 is ideal for users who want stable performance without compromising on efficiency. Its silent operation, fast recharge capability, and user-friendly indicators make it a reliable choice for everyday power management.


Key Features

  • 650VA/390W capacity suitable for essential electronics and small office setups
  • Line-Interactive design for automatic voltage regulation and stable output
  • Enhanced surge and spike protection to safeguard devices
  • Automatic transfer to battery mode with minimal switching time
  • LED status indicators showing power, battery, and load conditions
  • Built-in microprocessor control for increased reliability
  • Cold start function enabling use without main power
  • Fast battery recharge system for improved uptime
  • Compact and lightweight design, easy to place in home or office
  • Low noise operation ensuring a comfortable working environment
